Generative AI Is Not Going To "Eat" The Games Industry, Expert Says
description: Recently, popular video game stocks like GTA 6 owner Take-Two ($TTWO), game development engine Unity ($U), and sandbox game Roblox ($RBLX) saw huge sell-offs that hammered share prices in the wake of Google's announcement of a new generative AI tool called Project Genie. The product claims it can create worlds "generated in real time," and people quickly put it to use to create rip-offs of Mario and Fortnite, among many others. The generative AI tool seemingly spooked some investors, prompting the stocks to get hammered. But how big of a threat to the industry mainstays is Project Genie, or generative AI systems like it? "Wall Street has lost the plot again" Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics told GameSpot that "Wall Street has lost the plot again" and that generative AI is "not coming to eat the games industry." title: GTA 6 Still On Track For November Release, Marketing Campaign Kicks Off This Summer
description: As part of Take-Two's earnings announcement today, the company confirmed that Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI remains on track for release on November 19, 2026. There was no reason to believe it might be delayed again, but the company said today that it remains on track. GTA 6 was originally set to release in Fall 2025 before it shifted to May 26, 2026 and then again to November 19, 2026. Rockstar said it needed more time to make the game the best it could be. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick told IGN that marketing for GTA 6 will begin in earnest this summer. "Any time you're getting closer to marketing beats, you're obviously in a place where your confidence level is as high as it can be," he said of GTA 6 making it out on time this November. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Take A Look At These Two Chappell Roan Fortnite Skins Coming This Week
description: After a few weeks of rumors, Epic Games finally revealed that Chappell Roan will be the next Fortnite Festival headlining artist when the new music pass launches on Thursday, February 5. As is usually the case with these things, Roan will have a skin, the Pink Pony Club jam track, and other cosmetics on the new Heartcore music pass, along with an additional set of items and jam tracks available for direct purchase in the item shop. Buying the music pass--which is included with Fortnite Crew, or can be purchased on its own for 1400 V-Bucks--will instantly unlock the Chappell Roan skin. Players can then unlock the rest of the items on the pass, including several musical instruments and an additional style for the Chappell Roan skin, by gaining XP in any Fortnite mode. There should be a number of jam tracks other than Pink Pony Club included on the pass, but we don't know what they are yet. And there will also be some free items on the pass that you can earn without buying it. Gallery Over in the shop, we'll have the Roan of Arc skin, with the singer sporting her iconic armored look from the 2024 VMAs. Roan will also be the first Festival Headliner to have a sidekick--a Pink Pony in the style of a Fortnite piñata--which will be part of her shop bundle. Typically, a season headliner also has at least two new jam tracks in the shop, but Epic's announcement didn't mention any new songs other than Pink Pony Club. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Alamo Drafthouse's Resident Evil-Inspired Menu Includes A Jill Sandwich
description: Resident Evil Requiem is just a few weeks away, but Alamo Drafthouse is starting the party early with its Resident Evil-inspired menu for its upcoming free screenings. Jill Valentine may not be in Requiem, but the original RE heroine is finally getting Jill's Sandwich, which is a play on the infamous line in the first game. For the record, a Jill's Sandwich is comprised of double all-beef patties, applewood smoked bacon, melty cheese, pickles, a special burger sauce, and a butter-toasted bun. You can wash that down with a T-Virus Cocktail or a Blue Umbrella Serum, although the Drafthouse employees will probably give you a soda if you ask for it. Jill's SandwichThe other items on this menu are the Red + Green Herb Hot Dog Combo--which doesn't feature any healing effects from the herbs--and Bingo! Fried Chicken. These items are only available during the Raccoon City Cinema screenings from February 6-27. The films in this mini festival include The Cabin in the Woods, The Thing, The Ring, and Longlegs. The latter is an apt choice, since Longlegs star Maika Monroe recently appeared in a live-action trailer for Resident Evil Requiem. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Rainbow Six Siege Loses Creative Director, Replacement Revealed
description: Rainbow Six Siege creative director Alexander Karpazis is stepping down from his role on the game. Ubisoft announced in a blog post that Karpazis is giving up the role he's held since January 2022, with Ubisoft veteran Joshua Mills taking over in that role. Karpazis had worked on Siege for eight years and was previously the game's art director before rising to become the overall creative director. "I cannot put into words the number of ways this game has impacted my life; the incredible team that I have been a part of, the work we have achieved together, the adventures I have gone on, and the people I have met along the way have had a profound effect on me and have enriched my life season after season," Karpazis said. "It has been an honor spending half my professional career working on Siege." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: MLB The Show 26 Takes Players From College To The Hall Of Fame
description: Getting into the Baseball Hall of Fame is an impossible dream for most professional players, but that journey will be part of a new addition to MLB The Show 26. This year, the game will let players track their character through college and into the Major Leagues. And if they finish Road To The Show: Road to Cooperstown, then a spot in the Hall of Fame awaits. The number of the college teams is increasing this year from 11 to 19, with University of Arkansas, University of Florida, Stanford University, and University of Michigan among the schools lending their names, logos, and roster to the game. MLB The Show 26 is also adding the College World Series format and bracket. Diamond Dynasty is back the game as well, with the World Baseball Classic. Through this mode, baseball goes international with stops in the Tokyo Dome and Estadio Hiram Bithorn. Over 500 new gameplay animations have been added, as well as new hitting and pitching interfaces. Fresh rewards and challenges will also be offered through the game's live-service updates. title: Did Fallout Season 2 Episode 7 Hint That The Worst Fallout: New Vegas Ending Could Be Canon?
description: With The Ghoul reactivating Mr. House, Lucy discovering the mainframe of her father’s devices, and Maximus having to protect Freeside, the penultimate episode of Fallout season two raised the stakes for an all-out finale in New Vegas. Yet for as much time as this episode dedicated to building up relationships and faction statuses, episode seven still delivered the goods when it came to action and references to the original games. With that being said, let’s dive right in to this week’s easter eggs: New (California) Threads When The Ghoul (Walton Goggins) and Maximus realize they need to stock up to battle the Deathclaws that are overrunning the strip, they head to a secret New California Republic armory. While at first nothing seems to stand out amongst the arsenal of weapons, a single piece stands out: an NCR themed suit of power armor. While we’re not quite sure why this even exists, there’s no denying the power of good brand recognition. Not A Ghoul But Something Much Worse Throughout the episode, Thaddeus’ (Johnny Pemberton) condition worsens. Curious as to when his nose will fall off, he shows The Ghoul an alarming new mutation he’s developed: a gaping mouth growing in the center of his chest (in addition to his arm falling off). Now while it’s not quite confirmed what exactly he turning into, it’s definitely not a ghoul. For my money, he’s showing signs of turning into a Centaur. One of the most horrifying creatures in the Fallout universe. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Sony Files Patent For Generative-AI Podcast Starring Game Characters
description: Putting AI elements in games has already become a bigger part of the industry, and now Sony wants AI to talk about games as well. Sony has filed a patent for a generative AI podcast that would be starring its video game characters. The complete patent listing for Sony's LLM-based generative podcast for gamers puts forth some ambitious ideas even though it doesn't settle every issue that may arise from them. According to the listing, Sony sees these podcasts as a way to reach individual gamers with news tailored to their tastes that comes in the form of an audio or video podcast hosted by the main character or characters of a game recently played on the console. Deepfake voices will sidestep the need for actors, as the LLM creates banter and a news-like program that delivers tips, gaming news, and more games of interest to the player in question. The patent doesn't state if the generative podcast would be limited to Sony's proprietary characters or if it would extend to characters from third-party games. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Switch 2 Price Could Go Up By $50 Or $100, Expert Predicts
description: The Switch 2 could get a price hike in 2026, but how much more should people prepare to pay? According to Niko Partners analyst Daniel Ahmad, Nintendo may opt to raise the price of the Switch 2 by $50 or $100. The Switch 2 currently sells for $450 on its own or $500 with Mario Kart World. He said this against the backdrop of the impact of tariffs and increasing memory prices and how those factors could impact the Switch 2's price. Nintendo said in its latest earnings briefing that there will be no impact during the current fiscal year, but for the fiscal year that begins in April 2026, these factors could "put pressure" on the company's earnings, Ahmad said. "Would need to reconsider pricing / strategy at that point," Ahmad said. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Netflix's Ancient PS3 App Is Going Offline Next Month
description: Bad news for PlayStation 3 owners hoping to watch Love is Blind on their CRT: Netflix is discontinuing the streaming app from Sony's legacy console a month from now. A Reddit post from a CRT-enthusiast community shared the announcement seen on the PS3 Netflix app, which reads: "Unfortunately, Netflix will no longer be available on this device after March 2, 2026." Streaming services phasing out support for older devices shouldn't be a surprise, but what's striking about this shutdown is how long the PS3 Netflix app was functioning. Netflix launched for PS3 in late 2009--but due to an exclusivity deal that the streaming giant had with Xbox, the service was only available through a disc that the company sent in the mail. It took until later in 2010 for Netflix on PS3 to go disc-free with a downloadable app. Netflix had a similar arrangement for the Wii, but that app was discontinued in 2018. Continue Reading at GameSpot
